title: An overview of software-defined networking (SDN) and controllers

videos.script: Every router in this course does two jobs. It decides where traffic should go, and it sends it there. {{two}} Deciding is the control plane. Sending is the data plane. And every router does both, for itself. {{planes}} Software-defined networking takes the deciding out of the boxes. One program, the controller, decides for all of them. {{controller}} The switches keep a table of flows, and the controller writes it. {{flows}} In this lesson you start with a switch that forwards nothing, and give it flows by hand. {{empty}} Then a controller learns the hosts and writes the flows itself. {{learn}} You add a rule for the whole network in one place, and watch one host lose its way to another. {{policy}} And then you stop the controller, and see exactly what the network still does without it. {{down}}
